correctness.rationale: A projective frame normalizes the nine labelled dual points to a one-parameter family a with excluded values a=0,1 and roots of a^2−a+1; direct determinant computation yields precisely the eleven triples required by the eight prescribed flats and all other 73 minors factor only at excluded parameters. Independently constructed the 20x12 matrix of degree-four logarithmic-derivation tangencies using twelve quadratic coefficients, by substituting a general point on each remaining line. Its designated twelve-row determinant symbolically equals a^14(a−2)(a−1)^20(a^2−a+1)^3, giving rank 12 for all admissible a≠2. At a=2 independent exact rank=11 and kernel vector (−1,6,4,2,3,8,9,8,8,20,16,20); a lower-degree syzygy would generate at least three independent degree-four multiples, contradicting one-dimensionality. The quadruple intersection supplies degree-five syzygy uniformly. Thus mdr=4 precisely at a2, else 5, over all complex parameters of the fixed labelled lattice; symbolic identities are genuinely global, not a finite scan.
